verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a, yujto ha hin Jehová hin tik wach' hinnhej.
k'anab'ajejek he mam he nun. Tze k'anab'ajej sleyal juntzanh sk'uhal ik'oj ip to wik yaji. Ha hin ton Jehová he Diosal hin swala'.
Manh heyak'och he pensar t'a juntzanh yechel komon Dios, manh he b'opaxk'e k'e'en k'e'en he diosalok. Ha hin ton Jehová he Diosal hin swala'.
Ayik tzeyak'an silab' yik he junk'olal wet'ok, tze k'anab'ajej wal icha sleyal, yuj chi' ol hin cha t'ayex.
Ha nok' schib'ejal nok' tzeyak' silab'il chi', tze chi nok' t'a sk'uhal chi' yet' t'a junxo k'u. Tato ayto nok' skan t'a schab'ji'al, snhuschajtz'a nok'.
Tato tzato he chi nok' t'a schab'ji'al chi', chukxo t'a yol hin sat, maxtzak hin chalaj silab' chi' t'ayex.
Ha mach schi'an nok' t'a schab'ji'al chi', max tuplaj smul chi' t'a yib'anh, yujto komon ix yutej tastak to wik yaji. Ha jun mach chi', manhxalaj yalan yik t'a he kal.
Ayik tze molank'e sat tas tzeyawej t'a he lu'um, manh pilanok tzeyutej he molank'e t'a stitak, manh hex ek' t'anhanh he sik'ank'e ixim jolom trigo skan heyu'uj.

Ayik tze molan sat te' uwa, manh hex meltzaj he say heyil t'a scha'elal, manh he sik'k'e sat sk'ajb'anemi. Ha juntzanh chi' kanokab'i, yikxo heb' meb'a' yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yaji. Ha hin ton Jehová he Diosal hin swala'.
Manh hex elk'anok, manh heyal esal lolonel, manh heyak' musansatil heb' heyetanima'il.
Manh he lok hin b'i t'a es. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej ichato malaj welk'och t'ayex. Ha hin ton Jehová hin swala'.
Manh komonok tzeyixtej heb' heyetanima'il, manh he tok'ek' tastak ay t'a heb'. Manh heyala' to hato k'ik'an tze tup sk'u heb' winh he munlajwum smunlaj tikne'ik.
Manh he b'aj heb' chakanh, manh heyak'em tas t'a yol sb'e heb' max uji yilani, palta ayokab' welk'och t'a yol he sat. Ha hin ton Jehová hin swala'.

Manh he b'o tas manh tojolok ayik tze b'o'an yaj junok lolonel. Manh heyak'och he b'a yet' heb' meb'a', manh heyak'paxoch he b'a yet' heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Te tojolnhej tzeyutej he b'o'anel tas yaj heb'.
Manh hex alwok pekal t'a skal heb' heyetchonhab'. Manh he nacha'anh esal lolonel t'a yib'anh junok heyetanima'il yik smiljichamok. Ha hin ton Jehová hin swala'.
Mokab' chichonoch he k'o'ol t'a junok heyetanima'il, palta wach' to tze kacha' tzeyak'an srazón yik wach' max kotkan t'a heyib'anh yet'ok.
Manh he pak he b'a, mokab' chichonnhejoch he k'o'ol t'a heb' heyetchonhab'. Tze xajanej heb' ay t'a spatik schikin he pat icha tzeyutej he ya ilan he b'a. Ha hin ton Jehová hin swala'.

k'anab'ajejek juntzanh hin cheknab'il tik. Manh he cha tajnok nok' he molb'etzal nok' yet' junokxo nok' nok' ch'ok yinhtilal. Manh he som heyinhat tzeyawej t'a he lu'um. Manh heyak'och k'apak pichul soman sch'alil yet' junokxo makan anh ch'al.

Tato ay junok ix schekab' junok mach ayxo strato yet' junokxo winh winak, palta tato ay junokxo winh smulan yet' ix, tz'ak'ji yowalil t'a heb' schawanhil. Max miljichamlaj heb', yujto mantzak tupji yik tz'el ix t'a libre.
Ha winh smulan yet' ix chi', yowalil syik'kot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel winh silab'il yuj smul chi' t'a sti'elxo hin kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox hin b'a.
Smiljicham nok', haxo junok winh sacerdote tz'ak'anoch nok' t'a wichanh, yuj stupchaj smul winh chi'.
Ayik ol hex k'och t'a lum Canaán, ol heyawan masanil makanhil te awb'en te' syak' sat. Oxe' ab'il max heyamlaj junok sat te' chi' yik tze lo'ani, yujto ay yowalil t'a yol hin sat.
Haxo t'a schanhil ab'il, masanil sat te' syak' chi', tzeyak' masanil t'ayin ofrenda'il yuj heyak'an yuj diosal, yujto wik yaj te' sat chi'.
Haxo t'a yo'il ab'il, heyikxo yaj sat te' chi' yik tze lo'o. Tato ol he k'anab'ajej sleyal tik, yelxo wal ol yak' sat te'. Ha hin ton Jehová he Diosal hin swala'.
Manh he chi nok' chib'ej to max el schik'il. Manh heyak'och he b'a he na'anel tas tzuji, manh heyak'paxoch he b'a t'a ajchumal.
Manh setansetanok tz'aj sjoxji'el xil he jolom, manh he joxpaxel xil he sat.
Manh heyak' echnaj he b'a yuj kusk'olal yuj junok chamnak, manh heyak'och yechel junok tas t'a he niwanil. Ha hin ton Jehová hin swala'.
Manh heyak' k'ixwelal ix heyisil, tzeyak'anoch ix ajmul ixal t'a stemplo juntzanh komon Dios, yik wach' max ixtaxel sb'eyb'al heb' anima, yik max ixtaxpaxel he chonhab' yuj ajmulal.
Yowalil tze k'anab'ajej sleyal juntzanh sk'uhal ik'oj ip to wik yaji. Ayokab' yelk'och hin kajnub' t'a yol he sat. Ha hin Jehová hin swala'.
Manh hex b'at he k'anb'ej he b'a t'a heb' ajchum, ma t'a heb' sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak yalani, yik wach' max heyixtejb'at he b'a. Ha hin Jehová he Diosal hin swala'.
K'e'anhek linhan t'a yichanh heb' ichamtak anima, niwanokab' yelk'och heb' t'a yol he sat. Ayokab'pax welk'och t'a yol he sat. Ha hin ton Jehová hin swala'.
Manh heyixtej junok anima ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal.

Xajan tzeyutej heb', ichato heyetchonhab' heb'. Ya'ilejek heb', icha tz'aj heya'ilan he b'a. Tze nakoti to ha hex tik najtil ek'nak hex t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yol yik Egipto. Ha hin ton Jehová he Diosal hin swala'.
Manh heyixtej heb' anima t'a tas tze chonho', tz'akanokab' heyechlab' tzeyak'lab'ej, icha he ch'anh ayik tzeyechtan he lu'um ma juntzanhxo echlab' tze k'ana'.
Ha he libra yet' heyalmul tze k'ana', tz'akanokab'i. Ha hin ton Jehová he Diosal hin ix hex wik'elta t'a Egipto, ha hin swala'.
Yuj wal chi', yowalil tze k'anab'ajej hin b'eyb'al yet' masanil hin cheknab'il tik. Ha hin ton Jehová hin swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
